description: order.cancelled (S-151) — topic orders.order, key = order id. A goods order, or one shop's part of it, was cancelled (customer before packing, a shop for its lines, Northline staff, or a failed delivery refunded): the lines' card holds are voided or refunded and the delivery leaves its run. Ids and codes only: no note, no customer.

reason.description: a reason code (customer: changed_mind | ordered_by_mistake | delivery_too_late | found_elsewhere | other; merchant: out_of_stock | cannot_fulfil | customer_request | suspected_fraud | other; staff: customer_request | merchant_request | fraud | payment_issue | delivery_issue | other; delivery_failed)

whole.description: the whole order is closed, else only merchantIds' lines

merchantIds.description: merchants.merchants.id of the shops whose lines were cancelled

state.description: the order's state now: cancelled | refunded (a failed delivery) | its state when only part of it was cancelled
